description: This file defines the Category model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for database interactions related to product categories, such as retrieving category details, filters, layout IDs, and lists of categories.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Model class for handling category data interactions with the database in the OpenCart system, including methods to retrieve category details, filters, layout IDs, and lists of categories.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a single category record based on category ID, joining category, description, and store tables, returning the record as an associative array.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories with a specific parent ID, ordered by sort order and name, returning an array of category records.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves filter groups and associated filters for a given category ID, returning a structured array of filter group data.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a given category ID for the current store; returns 0 if not found.
